S7.published:
His inner child guide (The Chicken-and-Egg Problem), his own words: "That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, not three more people moving in to help with the rent, and each job keeps the others in balance."
(The published hypnosis guide: "I organize that adult capacity into three functions: Nurturer, Protector, and Leader/Guru. They aren’t three literal beings. They’re three ways the present-day person reparents the inner child.")
S7.paragraph_after: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. It’s one person doing three jobs rather than getting three more people to move in with you to help with the rent! Each job keeps the others in balance. It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.
S7.paragraph_before: Your inner child won’t trust you right away. It’s not going to be enough for you to meditate, say three nice sentences to the inner child and expect to have its trust. What’s going to help your inner child to trust you is you, the person you are right now, becoming reliable.
S7.paragraph_next: Also, your inner child’s worth is not dependent on these qualities… It has its own worth, and its own qualities, like playing, being tender, not taking life too seriously, being creative and wondering at the world. Those belong in your relationship with it too, not just the wounds.

S9.paragraph_after: One important thing to become aware of when approaching your inner child is your inherited parent script. Your parent script is made up of a collection of rules and ways of treating yourself that you adopted as a child (mostly based on how you were treated by your parent(s)). It doesn’t always take the form of a voice. This is not the inner adult (Nurturer, Protector, Guide) that you consciously build. Often this script acts as a critic or warden, telling your inner child not to cry, not to be “needy”, not to embarrass them, not to be too independent, etc. So when you begin talking to your child in a new, loving way, the script may jump in to say that what you’re doing is “fake”.

When intoxicated, acutely confused, or unable to keep yourself safe, deal with immediate support rather than exploratory hypnosis. S3a2.paragraph_after: Put yourself in a place where you can safely do this. Don't do this if you're driving, in the water, operating machinery, or otherwise need to be attending to yourself or other people. If you are intoxicated, acutely confused, or not able to keep yourself safe, then get some immediate support instead of doing exploratory hypnosis. If you are already partially or fully opened, use the later 'Already open? Contain before you deepen' section to help orient yourself, but do not attempt to deepen yourself if you are not stable.
S3a2.paragraph_before: Get clear on what it is you want to do during the induction. What do you want not to do today? How long do you want to spend on this? (You don't have to do this on a problem. You can do it on something you want to experience more of: love, play, confidence, creativity, communion, whatever.) Make sure you're leaving some time at the end to come back, and reflect on what you experienced.
S3a2.paragraph_next: Deciding to do it. How will you coax yourself to do this? Make it spacious? Make it warm and held? Something else? Preview what you are going to do: will you close your eyes? Will you come out and go back in again? What will you do at the end? If you are going to use a recording, read the script if you can. Remind yourself that if you say 'stop' at any time, the induction will end. If you say 'less', you will be asked to do less. If you say 'quiet', the talking will stop. You can also just open your eyes and stop, and then come all the way back anyway. You don't need to ask any parts for permission to stop, even if a part tells you that you do.

S5b.paragraph_after: Here is some inner child love. Put your hand over your heart and your other hand on your solar plexus, and say to yourself in a loving way, “Little one, you are not alone. If you can’t do this in a loving way today, just put your hands there and see what you feel, no faking required.
